name: I-cholesterol ephezulu
sources: Lipid and Atherosclerosis Society of South Africa

what_is_it.heading: I-Cholesterol ngokujwayelekile
what_is_it.lede: I-cholesterol iyinto enamafutha umzimba wakho oyidingayo ukuze wakhe amaseli futhi wenze amahomoni. Inkinga uhlobo nenani - uhlobo oluningi olungalungile lunqwabelana ezindongeni zemithambo yegazi futhi lubangele ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo nokushaywa unhlangothi.
paragraphs: Isibindi sakho senza ingxenye enkulu ye-cholesterol yakho. Okunye futhi kuvela ekudleni, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni yezilwane. I-cholesterol ye-LDL ('bad') ithwala amafutha iwayise ezindongeni zemithambo yegazi. I-HDL ('good') cholesterol iyayisusa. Ibhalansi ibalulekile.

Abanye abantu bathole i-cholesterol ephezulu njengefa (i-hypercholesterolaemia yomndeni) - izinombolo zabo ziphezulu ngokuyingozi kusukela ebuntwaneni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi badlani. Lesi yisizathu esingaziwa kakhulu sokuhlasela kwenhliziyo kusenesikhathi. Uma isihlobo esiseduze sibe nesifo senhliziyo ngaphambi kweminyaka engama-60, hlolwa.

items.headline: Athule
items.body: I-cholesterol ephezulu ayinazo izimpawu. Wazi ngokuhlolwa kwegazi kuphela.

items.headline: Imbangela enkulu
items.body: Ngokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo nokushaywa unhlangothi okuningi. I-LDL iyisici esinamandla esingaguquguquka esinamandla esiyaziyo.

items.headline: Ukubalwa kofuzo
items.body: I-cholesterol ephezulu yomndeni ithinta cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabangama-200 - abaningi abazi kuze kube yilapho kuhlaselwa isifo senhliziyo.

items.headline: Ama-statins ayasebenza
items.body: Amashumi eminyaka obufakazi: ama-statins anciphisa ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo nokushaywa unhlangothi ngengxenye yesithathu noma ngaphezulu kubantu abasengozini.

pull_quote.text: I-cholesterol akuyona nje inkinga yendlela yokuphila. Abantu abazacile, abaqinile, abadla okunempilo basengaba ne-cholesterol ephezulu eyingozi ezakhini zofuzo. Hlola - ikakhulukazi uma noma ubani emndenini wakho enesifo senhliziyo ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
pull_quote.source: I-Lipid kanye ne-Atherossteosis Society yaseNingizimu Afrika

signs.heading: Ongase ukuqaphele
signs.lede: Kubantu abaningi: lutho. I-cholesterol ephezulu yenza umonakalo wayo buthule emashumini eminyaka. Okuwukuphela kwendlela yokwazi ukuhlola igazi.

items.title: Azikho izimpawu zansuku zonke
items.description: I-cholesterol ayikwenzi uzwe lutho. Isibonakaliso sokuqala kubantu abaningi isifo senhliziyo noma unhlangothi eminyakeni engamashumi amane noma amahlanu.

items.title: Amazinga aphezulu kakhulu ofuzo
items.description: Amabala aphuzi azungeze amajwabu amehlo noma amaqhubu okunamafutha emathangeni (Achilles, knuckles) angaba izimpawu ze-cholesterol yomndeni. Indandatho empunga ezungeze iris ngaphambi kweminyaka engama-45 ingenye.

items.title: Umlando womndeni uyinkomba
items.description: Abazali, izingane zakini, noma ogogo nomkhulu abanesifo senhliziyo noma imivimbo ngaphambi kweminyaka engama-60 - ikakhulukazi ngaphambi kweminyaka engama-50 - baphakamisa ngokuqinile i-cholesterol ephezulu yofuzo.

items.myth: Abantu abakhuluphele kuphela abathola i-cholesterol ephezulu.
items.fact: Abantu abazacile bathola i-cholesterol ephezulu - imvamisa ivela kufuzo. Ukuma komzimba akusona isignali ethembekile. Ukuhlolwa kwegazi kuphela.
I-cholesterol yokudla evela emaqanda inomphumela omncane ku-cholesterol yegazi kubantu abaningi. Amafutha asuthisiwe namafutha e-trans kubaluleke kakhulu.
Ucwaningo olukhulu alutholanga isixhumanisi. Ama-Statin kwesinye isikhathi abangela ubuhlungu bemisipha - tshela umtholampilo wakho uma kunjalo, zikhona ezinye izindlela.

items.myth: Uma ngivivinya umzimba, asikho isidingo sokukhathazeka ngokudla.
items.fact: Ukuzivocavoca ngokuvamile kuphakamisa i-HDL (i-cholesterol enhle) kodwa kunomphumela omncane kuphela ku-LDL. Ukudla, isisindo, kanye nemithi kubaluleke kakhulu ku-LDL.

prevention.heading: Uzehlisa kanjani izinombolo zakho
prevention.lede: I-cholesterol isabela kahle ekuhlanganisweni kokudla, isisindo, ukuvivinya umzimba, kanye nemithi lapho kudingeka khona. Abantu abaningi bangahambisa izinombolo zabo kakhulu phakathi nezinyanga.

items.title: Ukudla ngendlela yaseMedithera
items.description: Imifino, okusanhlamvu, okusanhlamvu, amantongomane, inhlanzi, amafutha omnqumo. Nciphisa inyama ebomvu, ibhotela, ubisi olugcwele ukhilimu, ukudla okuthosiwe, nenyama egayiwe.

items.title: Sika amafutha e-trans ngokuphelele
items.description: Kufihlwe ezimpahleni eziningi ezibhakwayo, kumajarini, nasezintweni ezidliwayo ezithosiwe. Funda amalebula - noma yini 'enamafutha ayingxenye ye-hydrogenated' isiphumile.

items.title: Hambisa nsuku zonke
items.description: Ukuzivocavoca kwenyusa i-HDL (uhlobo oluhle) futhi kusiza isisindo. Ngisho nokuhamba ngokushesha imizuzu engama-30 ngosuku kwenza umehluko olinganisekayo.

items.title: Ama-statins lapho kuboniswa khona
items.description: Uma ubungozi bakho buphezulu, noma une-cholesterol yomndeni, ama-statins ayindlela yokwelapha ephumelela kakhulu esinayo. Kumahhala emitholampilo.

items.title: Thola iphaneli ye-lipid
items.description: Ukuhlola igazi lokuzila ukudla kukala i-cholesterol ephelele, i-LDL, i-HDL, ne-triglycerides. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni kusukela eminyakeni engama-40 - noma ngaphambi kwalokho ngomlando womndeni.

items.title: Yazi izinombolo zakho
items.description: Zibhale phansi. I-LDL engaphansi kwe-3.0 ngokuvamile iyinhloso - ngaphansi kwe-1.8 uma usuvele unesifo senhliziyo noma isifo sikashukela. Okuhlosiwe kungokomuntu siqu - buza umtholampilo wakho.

items.title: Uma uphakeme - qala ngokudla nokunyakaza
items.description: Abantu abaningi bangehlisa i-LDL ngo-10-15% ngokudla nangokuvivinya umzimba kuphela. Yinike izinyanga ezintathu kuya kweziyisithupha ngaphambi kokuthi ucabangele ukuthi imithi iyadingeka.

items.title: Uma imithi inconywa - iqale
items.description: Ama-statins asebenza kangcono kakhulu nsuku zonke, isikhathi eside. Ukweqa imithamo kukhansela inzuzo enkulu. Imiphumela engemihle ayijwayelekile futhi ivamise ukulawuleka.

items.title: Phinda uhlole njalo ezinyangeni eziyi-12
items.description: Uma isizinzile, iphaneli ye-lipid yonyaka ihlola ukuqhubeka futhi ilungise ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Letha imiphumela yangaphambilini ukuze uyiqhathanise.

get_help.heading: Uzoqala kuphi
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa nge-cholesterol kumahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ingxenye enzima kakhulu ukuthola ukuhlolwa kokuqala - uma usunenombolo, indlela eya phambili icacile.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Wonke umtholampilo uhlinzeka ngokuhlolwa kwe-cholesterol mahhala kanye nama-statins amahhala lapho kunqunyelwe khona
